बॉलीवूड की खूबसूरत हसीना श्रद्धा कपूर ने मचा दिया है गदर!
फिल्म Eetha के ट्रेलर में उनका बिल्कुल नया और धांसू अंदाज दिख रहा है।
नौवारी साड़ी पहनकर उन्होंने महफिल लूट ली है और उनका ये तेवर फैंस को दीवाना बना रहा है। 🔥
क्या आपने अभी तक ये धमाकेदार ट्रेलर देखा या नहीं? 💃✨

ctx.title: Eetha Trailer Review: Shraddha Kapoor Is No Bechari In A Nauvari – Dances To Aasmaan Ka Mandap, Chaand Ki Light, Hawaaon Ka Speaker!
ctx.summary:
Shraddha Kapoor looks confident and glorious as Tamasha ki shaan Eetha Bai in the trailer of the film - here's our review! 
 The post  Eetha Trailer Review: Shraddha Kapoor Is No Bechari In A Nauvari – Dances To Aasmaan Ka Mandap, Chaand Ki Light, Hawaaon Ka Speaker!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Remember the teaser where Eetha goes into labor backstage and then walks right onto the stage, saying, “Padi padi mari toh bechari kehlaungi, naachte hue mari toh misaal ban jaaungi!”  Well, the trailer of Eetha will extend the impact of this powerful teaser, so rightfully! Where the teaser gave us one beat, the trailer gives us the whole stage! Directed by Laxman Utekar, the film is based on the life of a Tamasha and Lavani legend who spent decades performing for village crowds and won two Presidential honors. Maddock Films is backing it, and Shraddha Kapoor reunites with producer Dinesh Vijan after the Stree franchise. There’s no hero-style entry here, and that’s the twist. Eetha doesn’t make a grand arrival; she makes the arrival grand. Then comes the crowd, the ghungroo, and a woman ready to own the stage! Pushing her towards her aim and motivating her to move mountains is Md Zeeshan Ayyub, who tells her to dance in ‘aasmaan ka mandap, chaand ki light, and hawaaon ka speaker.’ The line sums up the film’s attitude: when you’re Eetha, the whole Universe is your stage! Trending Meethe Mein Kya Hai Trailer Review: Ritwik Bhowmik’s Family Reunion Has One Golden Rule — Avoid Everyone Akka Trailer Review: Forget The Angry Young Men, Keerthy Suresh & Radhika Apte Are Here To Rule With Guns & Gold The trailer takes us places, and Shraddha looks confident wearing a Nauvari and talking about it in utmost glory! She wears it like armor, not a costume. Eetha is not a bechari here; she’s the one who decides how her story ends. Her teaser dialogue about dying lying down versus dying while dancing has already gone viral, and the trailer carries that spirit forward. Eetha’s trailer is bold, grand, and emotional, and it makes one thing clear: this is Shraddha Kapoor’s most ambitious role yet. If the film can match its trailer, December 4 could belong to the Tamasha queen. Let the ghungroo roll, we say, and let the box office welcome another blockbuster from Shraddha Kapoor. Say why? Kyunki wo Stree Hai, wo Kuch bhi kar sakti hai! Check out the trailer of Eetha here. For more teaser and trailer reviews , stay tuned to Koimoi.
